text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle against Yamanin 
Zephyr, K.S.Miracle brilliantly claimed 
victory in the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her yearning for true speed burning even 
brighter, K.S. Miracle expressed her 
heartfelt gratitude to her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, thanks to the sprinters' 
success, excitement for sprint races was 
rising across the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under such circumstances, KS Miracle 
prepared for her next goal: the "Sprinters 
Stakes."
